sections.title: P12 — нормативный дизайн ошибок и наблюдаемости
0. Статус и границы
1.1 Общий словарь
1.2 Descriptor и package ownership
1.3 Compatibility
1.4 Result vs exception
sections.text:
| Situation | Form |
|:--|:--|
| Expected business denial | Typed result/decision with stable reason |
| Normal query absence | nullable/optional result |
| Programmer/configuration defect | typed exception |
| Infrastructure failure | typed exception with safe descriptor |
| Optimistic/concurrent conflict | domain conflict exception or explicit typed conflict |
| Batch partial failure | report with per-record descriptors; do not throw away successes |

P12.3 applies the rule only to measured attributes discrepancies. Repository-wide
conversion is excluded: without a caller contract it would be speculative and likely
breaking.

sections.title: 2. API projection and correlation (D61)
sections.text:
`ApiError` gains optional metadata **after** existing constructor parameters and
implements `DescribesError`. `ErrorMapper` order is:

1. explicit `ApiError` — preserve status;
2. `DescribesError` — copy descriptor, choose default HTTP status by category;
3. Laravel framework exceptions — current safe mapping enriched with category;
4. unknown — `internal_error`, report once, no original message/details.

Default status map is transport-only:

| Category | Status |
|:--|:--|
| authentication | 401 |
| authorization | 403 |
| validation | 422 |
| conflict | 409 |
| not_found | 404 |
| rate_limit | 429 |
| unsupported | 422 |
| unavailable | 503 |
| internal | 500 |

An exception may need an explicit API status only by becoming an `ApiError` at the API
boundary; core descriptor does not grow an HTTP field. `EnvelopeSerializer` remains
unchanged in P12 and a regression compares exact JSON keys and headers.

`RequestMetadata` appends `correlationId` with a compatible default. Incoming
`X-Correlation-ID` uses the same opaque 1–128 validation as request id. Missing/invalid
input falls back to the generated/preserved request id. It is internal until P13.

sections.title: 3. Concrete attributes corrections
sections.text:
P12.3 is the bounded proof for A94/A97:

| Current failure | New stable descriptor | Reason/outcome |
|:--|:--|:--|
| no qualified attributes engine | `attributes_engine_unavailable` | unavailable / `capability_unavailable`, non-retryable |
| current scope/connection denies operation | `attributes_access_denied` | authorization / `access_denied`, non-retryable |
| schema operation not ready or stale | `attribute_schema_conflict` | conflict; retryability decided by named constructor |
| retry budget exhausted | `attribute_schema_retry_exhausted` | conflict, non-retryable |

`ScopeDenied` stays for actual access denials. `SchemaOperationConflict` owns named
constructors `notReady`, `staleSnapshot`, `retryExhausted`; messages remain human-only.
The item updates only the two measured producers that currently misuse `ScopeDenied`.
It does not manufacture `capability_disabled` or `feature_not_entitled` producers.

sections.title: 4. Vendor-neutral operation lifecycle (D62)
5. Metrics and cardinality
sections.text:
`MetricAttributes` owns the only permitted metric dimension keys:

```php
private const ALLOWED = [
    'package', 'operation', 'outcome', 'category', 'retry_bucket',
];
```

Construction rejects an unknown key and a value outside the bounded forms. The OTel
adapter never accepts an arbitrary user map; it obtains dimensions from this type.
`retry_bucket` maps exact attempts to `0`, `1`, `2-3`, `4+`.

Forbidden metric labels include `account_id`, `workspace_id`, `actor_id`,
`correlation_id`, `causation_id`, `operation_id`, message id, subject and exception
class. They remain available in structured logs/traces where individual records do
not multiply time-series cardinality.

P5 `DeliveryHealth` exports only aggregate gauges/histogram:

```text
corex.messaging.outbox.oldest_pending.seconds
corex.messaging.outbox.pending
corex.messaging.outbox.publishing
corex.messaging.outbox.dead
corex.messaging.outbox.max_attempts
```

The per-contract age map is not converted to a metric label. It remains health-command
and structured-log detail.

sections.title: 6. OpenTelemetry and async messages (D63)
sections.text:
Both adapters are optional. `psr/log` and `open-telemetry/api` are `suggest` plus
`require-dev` for qualification, never `require`: the plan-wide rule forbids new
runtime dependencies. Their adapter classes are autoloaded only when a host explicitly
binds them. `CoreServiceProvider` binds no-op observer/trace bridge by default. An app
with the SDK explicitly binds `OpenTelemetryBridge`.

`TraceContextBridge` is deliberately tiny:

```php
interface TraceContextBridge
{
    /** @param array<string, scalar|null> $metadata */
    public function inject(array $metadata): array;

    /**
     * Run one consumer operation with producer context linked at span creation.
     *
     * @template T
     * @param array<string, scalar|null> $metadata
     * @param \Closure(): T $work
     * @return T
     */
    public function linkedConsumer(
        array $metadata,
        OperationContext $operation,
        \Closure $work,
    ): mixed;
}
```

The concrete OTel bridge uses the SDK propagator to write W3C `traceparent` and
optional `tracestate` into the existing P5 `MessageEnvelope::$metadata`. `SqlOutbox`
calls `inject()` synchronously before persistence; the relayed metadata therefore
survives process/queue boundaries. The consumer integration calls `linkedConsumer()`
around the processing closure; the null bridge calls it exactly once, while the OTel
bridge starts the linked span before invoking it and always closes the scope. Extraction,
span creation or shutdown failure must still invoke business work exactly once and cannot
replace its result or exception. `correlationId`/`causationId` are not parsed as trace ids
and remain available when tracing is absent.

Messaging semantic conventions are Development. The adapter pins the schema/version
it was tested against in one constant and documents it in `docs/reference.md`; an SDK
upgrade cannot silently change emitted names. CoreX custom health instruments use the
stable `corex.messaging.*` namespace.

sections.title: 7. Impersonation matrix (D64)
sections.text:
| Invariant | Current state | P12 action |
|:--|:--|:--|
| original actor vs effective user | `CurrentActor` has staff + target | enforce again at universal audit enqueue seam |
| immutable initiator/target | session fields exist | reject nested start before grant claim |
| non-empty reason | grant claim checks it | carry reason in state/session, root mirror and every audit entry |
| bounded expiry | checked at grant and request | retain; prove expired request stops before handler |
| write policy | L1/L2/L3 guards exist | no semantic change; regression matrix |
| revocation | root row checked each request | retain uncached check; claim only next protected request, not in-flight abort |
| failed login cleanup | grant burned but session is set first | logout/forget/invalidate; write failed-start mirror; never leave active state |
| every audit record | observer path only | enrich all `AuditLogger::record()` calls synchronously |

sections.title: 7.1 Core audit stamp
sections.text:
`ImpersonationState` appends compatible `?string $reason = null`. The real service
always constructs it with the grant reason. `AuditEntry::withImpersonation()` returns
a copy with:

```php
actorType: ActorType::Support
actorId: $state->staffIdentityId
context['impersonation'] = [
    'grant' => $state->grantId,
    'target_user_id' => $state->targetUserId,
    'reason' => $state->reason,
]
```

`QueuedAuditLogger::record()` resolves the current state and applies that copy before
event-time/workspace snapshot. Caller-supplied `context` is preserved except the
reserved `impersonation` key, which cannot override authority. The queued worker never
re-resolves actor/session.

sections.title: 7.2 Tenancy session lifecycle
8. Core-zone placement
sections.text:
Error and operation types are generic level-0 primitives. P12.1/P12.4 classify their
exact files as `Foundation` in the P6 map/gate; OTel/PSR adapters import no CoreX
capability zone and receive the same classification. P12 does not create an eleventh
zone or move FQCN. `AuditEntry` remains Audit; `ImpersonationState` remains
TenancyContracts.

sections.title: 9. Item map and dependency order
sections.text:
| Item | Normative sections | Package |
|:--|:--|:--|
| P12.1 | §1, §8 | core + root zone gate/docs |
| P12.2 | §2 | api |
| P12.3 | §1.4, §3 | attributes |
| P12.4 | §4 | core |
| P12.5 | §5–§6 | core |
| P12.6 | §7.1 | core |
| P12.7 | §7.2 | tenancy |
| P12.8 | all | root proof/policy/reference |

Data order: `P12.1 → {P12.2, P12.3, P12.4}`; `P12.4 → P12.5`;
`P12.1 → P12.6 → P12.7`; all → P12.8. B19 (`P12.2 + P12.3`) and
B20 (`P12.4 + P12.5`) are recommended shared-context batches but closure remains
per-item. P12.6/P12.7 stay solo/full because they change a security audit boundary.

sections.title: 10. Acceptance matrix
sections.text:
1. Existing code rename/category/retry change makes error-contract fixture red.
2. Invalid code/path/details shape is rejected before mapping.
3. Existing API JSON and headers are unchanged in P12.
4. Attributes cases map to three distinct machine outcomes; no message parsing.
5. Start + exactly one terminal observer event contains the same identity/context.
6. Raw Throwable/message/details never reach PSR-3/OTel adapters.
7. `account_id` or arbitrary metric label is rejected; allowed five pass.
8. OTel package absent: default boot/tests green; no exporter is required.
9. Producer trace carrier survives P5 metadata and consumer span is created with link;
   no correlation-to-trace fabrication.
10. Delivery health emits global metrics without account/contract dimensions.
11. Direct audit caller under impersonation is stamped with staff, target, grant and
    reason before queue dispatch.
12. Nested start does not consume second grant; failed login leaves no active session;
    expiry/revocation blocks next request; existing write guards stay closed.
13. P6 R-Z0/R-Z1/R-Z2 remains green and a planted unclassified observer file fails.
14. No response-envelope/problem+json snapshot appears before P13.

sections.title: 11. External-source boundary
sections.text:
Perplexity evidence and primary URLs are recorded in `P12-design-rag.md` and
`artifacts/P12-design-rag/`. External sources constrain interoperability and security
properties; they do not choose CoreX namespaces, item boundaries, codes, retry values,
HTTP mapping or audit storage. Those are D60–D64 and this repository's measured design.
